claims.text: The funding is for UK-based organisations hosting the grant.
The funding will not fund individuals without a formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for at least the project's duration.
The funding will not fund projects led by schools or further education colleges.
The funding will not fund projects led by undergraduates or master's students.
The funding will not fund PhD fees or projects where the main purpose is to support a PhD.
The funding will not fund projects led by organisations not based in the UK.

Exceptional overseas cases are possible for applications from overseas organisations if no UK-based host is feasible, provided strong plans for UK-focused dissemination, engagement, and impact are shown.
